## 2. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**2.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- All styling lives in `style.css`. **The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML.**
- Target all design properties, layout, and states exclusively via class/ID selectors.
- Keep HTML semantic and style-agnostic: a full re-theme must be achievable by editing `style.css` only.

**2.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
Store every visual token in `:root` and the `.dark` class. **No hardcoded hex, rgb, or rgba color values may appear outside these token blocks** — use `color-mix()` for translucency (e.g., navbar backdrop). Define exactly:

| Token | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|
| `--primary` | `#16A34A` | `#22C55E` |
| `--primary-strong` | `#15803D` | `#15803D` |
| `--secondary` | `#14532D` | `#DCFCE7` |
| `--bg-primary` | `#F7F8F3` | `#0B100D` |
| `--bg-secondary` | `#FEFEFE` | `#121A15` |
| `--bg-table` | `#FEFEFE` | `#121A15` |
| `--bg-table-alt` | `#F3F4F6` | `#18221B` |
| `--accent-tint` | `#DCFCE7` | `#14532D` |
| `--text-primary` | `#111827` | `#F7F8F3` |
| `--text-secondary` | `#6B7280` | `#9CA3AF` |
| `--text-on-primary` | `#FEFEFE` | `#FEFEFE` |
| `--text-success` | `#15803D` | `#4ADE80` |
| `--text-error` | `#DC2626` | `#F87171` |
| `--border-default` | `#E5E7EB` | `#233029` |
| `--border-success` | `#16A34A` | `#22C55E` |
| `--border-error` | `#DC2626` | `#F87171` |

- **Contrast pairing (mandatory, both themes):** every light background token pairs with a dark text token and vice versa. `--accent-tint` backgrounds always pair with `--secondary` text (pre-validated in both themes). **Never use `#ffffff` — the nearest white is `#FEFEFE`.**
- **CTA contrast rule:** `#16A34A` under white text is only 3.3:1 (fails WCAG AA for normal text). Therefore solid CTA button backgrounds use `--primary-strong` (`#15803D`, 5.0:1 with `#FEFEFE` labels); reserve `--primary` for icons, links, focus rings, badges, and hover accents.
- Structural tokens: `--radius-sm: 8px; --radius-md: 14px; --radius-lg: 24px;` `--shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.05); --shadow-md: 0 18px 45px rgba(15,23,42,0.04);` (dark theme overrides shadows to `rgba(0,0,0,0.4)` / `rgba(0,0,0,0.45)`); `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem; --spacing-section: clamp(2rem, 8vw, 6rem);` `--transition-fast: 150ms; --transition-normal: 250ms; --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);` `--z-dropdown: 100; --z-modal: 1000; --z-toast: 1100;` `--container-max: 1120px;` `--font-base`.
- Apply `letter-spacing: -0.02em` globally per the style spec.

**2.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support (full, both mechanisms)**
- Define dark tokens under **both** `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` **and** a `.dark` class on `<html>` (media query handles first paint; class handles manual override).
- Theme switching must require zero HTML restructuring — only variable reassignment.
- Persist the user's choice in `localStorage` (key: `metricflow-theme`), falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit. Set the `color-scheme` property accordingly.
- Provide a visible toggle (Material Symbols `dark_mode` / `light_mode`) with correct `aria-pressed` and dynamic `aria-label` ("Switch to dark mode" / "Switch to light mode").

**2.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- Build every layout structure with Flexbox. **Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center`** unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment (e.g., multi-line card body text may use `flex-start`).
- Mobile-first: rows convert to columns at defined breakpoints; fluid `clamp()` typography (hero `h1` ≈ `clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem)`); **zero horizontal page scroll at any viewport ≥ 320px**.

**2.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration**
- Use Tailwind CSS (CDN acceptable) or hand-authored CSS organized with Tailwind-style `@layer` / `@apply` discipline. Either way, generic reusable component classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`) must exist and map back to the CSS variables — no theme values hardcoded in utilities.

**2.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- Load **Google Font "Inter"** (weights 400–800) via `<link>`/`@import` and bind it to `--font-base`.
- Icons: **Google Material Symbols (Rounded)** via the official stylesheet. **Forbidden:** raw inline SVGs, local icon files, emoji as icons. The hero dot-cloud illustration must also be CSS-only (§3.7).
- *Exception clause:* the source spec requested a system-UI stack (`system-ui, -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI'`) — satisfy that aesthetic with Inter as the primary typeface and keep the system stack strictly as fallbacks after Inter; system fonts must not be the primary typeface.

## 3. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**3.1 Buttons**
- `.btn` base: `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px. Variants: `.btn--primary` (solid `--primary-strong` bg + `--text-on-primary` label), `.btn--secondary` (bordered/ghost), `.btn--danger` (see §4).
- **Hover:** brightness/shadow shift, `cursor: pointer`. **Focus-visible:** distinct ring via `outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px`. **Active:** `transform: scale(0.97)`. **Loading (`.is-loading`):** disables pointer events, prevents double-submits, renders a CSS spinner without changing button dimensions, sets `aria-busy="true"`. **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, grayscale, `cursor: not-allowed`. **Success/Error (`.is-success` / `.is-error`):** temporary feedback states using `--text-success` / `--text-error`, announced via `aria-live`.

**3.2 Cards**
- `.card` base: `--bg-secondary` background, `1px solid var(--border-default)`, `--radius-md`, `--shadow-sm`, flex layout.
- **Interactive cards only** (pricing tiers, integration cards): hover lifts with `transform: translateY(-2px)` and `--shadow-md`; **focus-within** highlights the border when a child control receives focus.
- Define `.skeleton` shimmer keyframes in `style.css` (for future dynamic content; not rendered on first paint) and an empty-state pattern (Material Symbol + guidance text) for dynamic slots.

**3.3 Forms & Inputs (Final CTA email capture)**
- `.input-group`: flex column wrapping a `<label>`, the input, and a dedicated error-feedback element with `aria-live="polite"`.
- Implement all states via CSS classes: empty, focused (outline ring), filled, valid (`--border-success` + `check` icon), invalid (`--border-error`, red error text, `error` icon), disabled, read-only.
- On submit: validate the email in JS → invalid shows inline error + `aria-live` announcement; valid shows button loading spinner → success state ("You're on the list") announced via `aria-live`. Never rely on color alone — pair every state with an icon and/or text.

**3.4 FAQ Accordion**
- Each item: `<h3><button aria-expanded="true|false" aria-controls="…">` + panel `id` match. Animate open/close with CSS only (prefer `grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr`). Chevron Material Symbol rotates 180° on open; open state is also indicated by border/weight change, not color alone. Fully keyboard operable with visible focus.

**3.5 Transactions Data Table**
- Semantic `<table>` with `<caption>` ("Recent transactions", visually styled but available to screen readers) and `<th scope="col">`.
- Alternating rows via `nth-child` using `--bg-table` / `--bg-table-alt`.
- Status badges: text label + Material Symbol — Paid (`check_circle`, success tone), Pending (`schedule`, neutral), Refunded (`undo`, error tone). **Never color-only.**
- Responsive: the table must never cause page-level horizontal scroll — wrap it in an `overflow-x: auto` container scoped to the preview card, or reflow rows into stacked records below 640px using `data-label` attributes.

**3.6 Modal / Popup (conditional)**
- If you implement any overlay (optional — e.g., a demo modal from the Hero's secondary CTA; if skipped, these rules still govern any future overlay): animated opening/open/loading/success-error/closing states via CSS transitions; centered flex container (`align-items: center`); backdrop overlay; Material Symbol `close` button; keyboard focus trapping; close via `Esc` and backdrop click; layered at `--z-modal`.

**3.7 Hero Dot-Cloud Illustration (CSS-only)**
- Build the abstract green data-point cloud with pure CSS: positioned dot elements styled via `nth-child` rules, or layered `radial-gradient` backgrounds on a single element. Dots vary in size (6–28px) and opacity using `--primary`, `--accent-tint`, and `--secondary`-family greens, arranged to suggest an ascending data trend.
- Add a subtle staggered float animation (translateY ±6px), disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Mark the container `aria-hidden="true"` (decorative). Scale down or relocate below the hero text on small screens.

## 4. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by default:** fluid sizing, defined breakpoints, zero horizontal overflow; `scroll-margin-top` on sections to offset the sticky navbar; smooth anchor scrolling (`scroll-behavior: smooth`, disabled under reduced motion).
- **Smooth animations:** `transition: var(--transition-normal) var(--ease-standard)` on all state changes; fully respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` (disable float/scale/transform animations, keep simple opacity).
- **Accessibility (a11y):** WCAG AA contrast in both light and dark modes; never communicate state by color alone; semantic HTML5 landmarks (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section[aria-labelledby]`, `footer`); correct ARIA roles/labels on custom widgets; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability (no mouse-only interactions); `aria-live` regions for form feedback and loading states; a skip-to-content link.
- **Mandatory visual feedback:** every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change (nav links, buttons, accordions, form submission, theme toggle).
- **Destructive actions:** `.btn-danger` must be visually distinct in both themes (not used on this page by default, but the class must exist and be themed for both modes).

- **JS scope (vanilla):** theme toggle + `localStorage` persistence, mobile nav, FAQ accordion, email form validation with loading/success/error feedback, smooth anchor scrolling. No frameworks required.
